title: Round-finding clock
statement: Let $m>0$, let $A$ and $\Gamma$ be types, let $\delta:A\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)\to A$, let $a_0\in A$, and let $\mathrm{acc}:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For an input list $x$ over $\Gamma$ and a configuration $d$ of the round-finding machine, define its clock to be the least positive time $t$ at which the machine's state is either the read phase with control value none or the exit phase with its unit control value; if no such time exists, define the clock to be $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $d$ for that input and machine
